turns.user_utterance: It went through at first, then later showed as “reverted” in the app.
turns.assistant_response:
Thanks—if it went through and later shows “reverted,” it’s a **reverted card payment**. This usually happens when the merchant’s request is cancelled or the payment can’t be completed (for example, merchant reversal, stock/authorization changes, or a temporary verification issue). 

Can you tell me the payment amount and whether it shows a date/time for the reversal (and any reference code) in the app? That will help narrow down the exact cause.
